messages:
alicia: Heads up — Zenith Cloud invoice #8232 (USD) failed an international EFT today. Bank returned 'beneficiary name mismatch'. Can finance confirm if we should request wire instructions or try manual collect?

mike: Got it. Do we have the exact bank rejection text/code from the bank? that helps compliance. Also, do we have a saved card on file?

alicia: Bank email included this: ```REJECT: Beneficiary name does not match beneficiary account records. Reject code: PAYE-3402. Expected beneficiary: 'Zenith Cloud, Inc.' Received: 'Zenith Cloud'```

nora: @alicia do we have a signed billing agreement with the corporate legal name? customer portal shows 'Zenith Cloud' but their contract PDF lists 'Zenith Cloud, Inc.' — I can attach the copy if useful.

mike: Thanks. PAYE-3402 is standard for name mismatch. Two practical paths: 1) request the customer provide corrected bank remittance instructions (slow but clean), or 2) ask for a one-time wire (we provide wire payload) and mark invoice as paid on receipt. If they prefer card, we can attempt manual collect if they have a card token. Which does the AM prefer? @paul

paul: cc @alicia @mike — I spoke with the customer earlier; finance contact (Ravi) is out today but legal is on the line. They want the wire route to confirm immediately. Can we send wire details + 24h hold and then reconcile when funds clear? Also they'll need an updated invoice with the full legal name to forward to their treasury.

alicia: OK I'll generate a wire-ready invoice with 'Zenith Cloud, Inc.' and include our SWIFT/ABA + remittance reference. drafting now. @finance-bot do we have any extra compliance checklist for inbound international wires > $50k?

finance-bot: Automated note: For inbound wires >= USD 50,000, require counterparty wiring form + corporate ID for AML review. Please escalate to compliance@redwood.com if threshold exceeded.

mike: Thanks @finance-bot. This invoice is for $18,450 so below the threshold. Wire path fine. Alicia — include the exact beneficiary name = 'Zenith Cloud, Inc.' and add our invoice reference: INV-8232. Also add net of bank charges instruction: 'payer to bear all correspondent bank fees' if customer requests net payment, we'll need gross-up.

alicia: Drafted and attached (will email to Ravi). Quick Q: should we also run a second attempt for ACH with the corrected beneficiary name, or keep single wire path to avoid double payment?

paul: Wire only for now, they'll confirm by EOD. If wire falls through we'll try corrected ACH.

mike: I'll flag the invoice in the system as 'pending manual wire' and disable auto-retry on ACH to prevent duplicate attempts. action items: Alicia sends wire-ready invoice (with legal name), Paul confirms with customer, Mike marks invoice and watches for remittance.

alicia: Sent invoice + wire instructions to Ravi; he replied :thumbsup: and said treasury will initiate same-day wire. I updated the invoice PDF filename to include 'legal-name-corrected'.

nora: Recording for audit: attached contract copy (shows 'Zenith Cloud, Inc.'), email thread. Good to close once funds settle.

mike: Great — leaving this thread open until funds appear. tagging here for visibility: @finance @accounts-receivable :eyes:
